questions.question: What is the border color of card "Ancestor's Chosen"?
questions.evidence: name of card  = 'Ancestor''s Chosen' ;
questions.SQL: SELECT DISTINCT borderColor FROM cards WHERE name = 'Ancestor''s Chosen'

questions.question: Among the sets of cards that have an Italian translation, how many of them have a base set number of under 100?
questions.evidence: Italian translation refers to language = 'Italian'; have a translation means translation is not null; base set number of under 100 refers to baseSetSize < 10
questions.SQL: SELECT COUNT(T1.id) FROM sets AS T1 INNER JOIN set_translations AS T2 ON T2.setCode = T1.code WHERE T2.translation IS NOT NULL AND T1.baseSetSize < 100 AND T2.language = 'Italian'

questions.question: What is the Simplified Chinese translation of the name of the set "Eighth Edition"?
questions.evidence: Eighth Edition is the name of card set which refers to name = 'Eighth Edition'; Simplified Chinese refers to language = 'Chinese Simplified'; translation of the name refers to translation
questions.SQL: SELECT T2.translation FROM sets AS T1 INNER JOIN set_translations AS T2 ON T2.setCode = T1.code WHERE T1.name = 'Eighth Edition' AND T2.language = 'Chinese Simplified'

questions.question: List all the card id and artist with unknown power which are legal for commander play format.
questions.evidence: unknown power refers to power = '*' or POWER IS NULL; commander play format refers to format = 'commander'; legal for commander play format refers to format = 'commander' where status = 'Legal'
questions.SQL: SELECT T1.id, T1.artist FROM cards AS T1 INNER JOIN legalities AS T2 ON T1.uuid = T2.uuid WHERE T2.status = 'Legal' AND T2.format = 'commander' AND (T1.power IS NULL OR T1.power = '*')

questions.question: Name the card and artist with the most ruling information. Also state if the card is a promotional printing.
questions.evidence: with the most ruling information refers to Max(count(rulings.uuid)); the card is the promotional printing refers to isPromo = 1;
questions.SQL: SELECT T1.name, T1.artist, T1.isPromo FROM cards AS T1 INNER JOIN rulings AS T2 ON T1.uuid = T2.uuid WHERE T1.isPromo = 1 AND T1.artist = (SELECT artist FROM cards WHERE isPromo = 1 GROUP BY artist HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT uuid) = (SELECT MAX(count_uuid) FROM ( SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT uuid) AS count_uuid FROM cards WHERE isPromo = 1 GROUP BY artist ))) LIMIT 1

questions.question: Calculate the percentage of the cards availabe in Chinese Simplified.
questions.evidence: Chinese Simplified' is the language; percentage = Divide(Sum(id where language = 'Chinese Simplified'), Count(id)) *100
questions.SQL: SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T2.language = 'Chinese Simplified' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(T1.id) FROM cards AS T1 INNER JOIN foreign_data AS T2 ON T1.uuid = T2.uuid

questions.question: List all the frame styles and cards Allen Williams worked on and find any banned cards if there are any.
questions.evidence: frame styles refers to frameVersion; cards Allen Williams worked on refers to artist = 'Allen Williams'; banned cards refers to status = 'Banned'
questions.SQL: SELECT DISTINCT T1.frameVersion, T1.name , IIF(T2.status = 'Banned', T1.name, 'NO') FROM cards AS T1 INNER JOIN legalities AS T2 ON T1.uuid = T2.uuid WHERE T1.artist = 'Allen Williams'

questions.question: What is the percentage of Story Spotlight cards that do not have a text box? List them by their ID.
questions.evidence: Story Spotlight cards that do not have a text box refers to isStorylight = 1 and isTextless = 0; Percentage = DIVIDE(SUM(count(id) where isStorylight = 1 AND isTextless = 0 ), SUM(count(id))) * 100
questions.SQL: SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN isTextless = 0 AND  isStorySpotlight = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(id) FROM cards

questions.question: How many cards have infinite power?
questions.evidence: infinite power refers to power = '*';
questions.SQL: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cards WHERE power = '*'

questions.question: What is the percentage of borderless cards?
questions.evidence: borderless card refers to borderColor = 'borderless'; percentage = Divide(Count (id) where borderColor = 'borderless', Count(id)) *100
questions.SQL: SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN borderColor = 'borderless' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(id) FROM cards

questions.question: How many unknown power cards contain info about the triggered ability
questions.evidence: unknown power cards refers to power is null or power = '*';contain info about the triggered ability refers to text contains 'triggered ability'
questions.SQL: SELECT Count(DISTINCT T1.id) FROM cards AS T1 INNER JOIN rulings AS T2 ON T1.uuid = T2.uuid WHERE (T1.power IS NULL OR T1.power = '*') AND T2.text LIKE '%triggered ability%'

questions.question: Which of these artists have designed a card in the set Coldsnap, Jeremy Jarvis, Aaron Miller or Chippy?
questions.evidence: card set Coldsnap refers to name = 'Coldsnap'; Jeremy Jarvis, Aaron Miller or Chippy are the name of artists which refers to artist IN ('Jeremy Jarvis', 'Aaron Miller','Chippy');
questions.SQL: SELECT T1.artist FROM cards AS T1 INNER JOIN sets AS T2 ON T2.code = T1.setCode WHERE (T2.name = 'Coldsnap' AND T1.artist = 'Chippy') OR (T2.name = 'Coldsnap' AND T1.artist = 'Aaron Miller') OR (T2.name = 'Coldsnap' AND T1.artist = 'Jeremy Jarvis') GROUP BY T1.artist

questions.question: What are the borderless cards available without powerful foils?
questions.evidence: borderless' refers to borderColor; poweful foils refers to cardKingdomFoilId paired with cardKingdomId AND cardKingdomId is not null
questions.SQL: SELECT id FROM cards WHERE borderColor = 'borderless' AND (cardKingdomId IS NULL OR cardKingdomId IS NULL)

questions.question: Lists all types of cards in German.
questions.evidence: German refer to language; all types refer to the subtypes, supertypes; subtypes is not null AND supertypes is not null
questions.SQL: SELECT T1.subtypes, T1.supertypes FROM cards AS T1 INNER JOIN foreign_data AS T2 ON T1.uuid = T2.uuid WHERE T2.language = 'German' AND T1.subtypes IS NOT NULL AND T1.supertypes IS NOT NULL

questions.question: Is the set of cards with Adarkar Valkyrie only available outside the United States?
questions.evidence: card set Adarkar Valkyrie refers to name = 'Adarkar Valkyrie'; isForeignOnly = 1 means only available outside the United States;
questions.SQL: SELECT IIF(isForeignOnly = 1, 'YES', 'NO') FROM cards AS T1 INNER JOIN sets AS T2 ON T2.code = T1.setCode WHERE T1.name = 'Adarkar Valkyrie'

questions.question: What is the percentage of incredibly powerful cards in the set Coldsnap?
questions.evidence: card set Coldsnap refers to name = 'Coldsnap'; foil is incredibly powerful refers to cardKingdomFoilId is not null AND cardKingdomId is not null; the percentage of incredibly powerful cards in the set refers to DIVIDE(SUM(incredibly powerful), SUM(name = 'Coldsnap'))*100
questions.SQL: SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T1.cardKingdomFoilId IS NOT NULL AND T1.cardKingdomId IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(T1.id) FROM cards AS T1 INNER JOIN sets AS T2 ON T2.code = T1.setCode WHERE T2.name = 'Coldsnap'

questions.question: Among the Artifact cards, which are black color and comes with foreign languague translation?
questions.evidence: Artifact card refers to originalType = 'Artifact'; black color refers to colors = 'B'; foreign language refers to language in foreign_data
questions.SQL: SELECT DISTINCT T1.name FROM cards AS T1 INNER JOIN foreign_data AS T2 ON T1.uuid = T2.uuid WHERE T1.originalType = 'Artifact' AND T1.colors = 'B'

questions.question: List the names of all the cards in the set Hour of Devastation and find the formats in which these cards are legal.
questions.evidence: the set Hour of Devastation refers to set.name = 'Hour of Devastation'; names of all the cards in the set refers to cards.name; legal cards refers to status = 'Legal'; the formats refers to format
questions.SQL: SELECT DISTINCT T2.name , CASE WHEN T1.status = 'Legal' THEN T1.format ELSE NULL END FROM legalities AS T1 INNER JOIN cards AS T2 ON T2.uuid = T1.uuid WHERE T2.setCode IN ( SELECT code FROM sets WHERE name = 'Hour of Devastation' )

questions.question: Please list the Italian names of the cards in the set Coldsnap with the highest converted mana cost.
questions.evidence: card set Coldsnap refers to name = 'Coldsnap'; Italian refers to language = 'Italian'; highest converted mana cost refers to MAX(convertedManaCost)
questions.SQL: SELECT T2.name FROM foreign_data AS T1 INNER JOIN cards AS T2 ON T2.uuid = T1.uuid INNER JOIN sets AS T3 ON T3.code = T2.setCode WHERE T3.name = 'Coldsnap' AND T1.language = 'Italian' ORDER BY T2.convertedManaCost DESC

questions.question: What language is the set of 180 cards that belongs to the Ravnica block translated into?
questions.evidence: set of 180 cards refers to baseSetSize = 180
questions.SQL: SELECT T2.language FROM sets AS T1 INNER JOIN set_translations AS T2 ON T1.code = T2.setCode WHERE T1.block = 'Ravnica' AND T1.baseSetSize = 180

questions.question: What is the mana cost of cards with a normal layout, a 2003 frame version, with a black border color, and available in paper and mtgo?
questions.evidence: available in paper and mtgo refers to availability = 'mtgo,paper'; frameVersion = 2003;borderColor = 'black'
questions.SQL: SELECT manaCost FROM cards WHERE availability = 'mtgo,paper' AND borderColor = 'black' AND frameVersion = 2003 AND layout = 'normal'

questions.question: Find and list the names of sets which doesn't have Japanese translation but have Korean translation.
questions.evidence: names of sets refers to name; doesn't have Japanese translation refers to language not like '%Japanese%'; have Korean translation refers to language = 'Korean'
questions.SQL: SELECT name FROM sets WHERE code IN ( SELECT setCode FROM set_translations WHERE language = 'Korean' AND language NOT LIKE '%Japanese%' )

questions.question: For artifact type of cards that do not have multiple faces on the same card, state its legalities status for vintage play format.
questions.evidence: Artifact type of cards refers to types = 'Artifact'; card does not have multiple faces on the same card refers to side is NULL'; vintage play format refers to format = 'vintage';
questions.SQL: SELECT DISTINCT T2.status FROM cards AS T1 INNER JOIN legalities AS T2 ON T1.uuid = T2.uuid WHERE T1.type = 'Artifact' AND T2.format = 'vintage' AND T1.side IS NULL

questions.question: What is the foreign name of the card in French of type Creature, normal layout and black border color, by artist Matthew D. Wilson?
questions.evidence: in French refers to language = 'French'; black border color refers to borderColor = 'black'
questions.SQL: SELECT name FROM foreign_data WHERE uuid IN ( SELECT uuid FROM cards WHERE types = 'Creature' AND layout = 'normal' AND borderColor = 'black' AND artist = 'Matthew D. Wilson' ) AND language = 'French'

questions.question: What are the cards belong to duel deck a? List the ID.
questions.evidence: duel deck a refers to duelDeck = a;
questions.SQL: SELECT id FROM cards WHERE duelDeck = 'a'

questions.question: What is the language of the card with the multiverse number 149934?
questions.evidence: multiverse number 149934 refers to multiverseid = 149934;
